techParks.name: Embassy TechVillage
techParks.description: Embassy REIT's 103-acre SEZ campus on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road at Devarabeesanahalli; in this lens it holds JPMorgan's 1.1 million sq ft built-to-suit corporate centre (Block 8D), the Wells Fargo Centre, ANZ's Hibiscus tower, and EXL and Fractal in Tower 2D / ETV-1.

techParks.name: Embassy GolfLinks Business Park
techParks.description: Embassy's 4.5 million sq ft business park off the Intermediate Ring Road beside the KGA golf course, built as named blocks (Pinehurst, Pebble Beach, Crystal Downs, Pine Valley); Fidelity's FBSI registered office is in Pinehurst and KPMG India in Pebble Beach.

techParks.name: Prestige Tech Park
techParks.description: Prestige Group's campus on the Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli built as named blocks (Mercury, Vector, Etamin, Exora, Falcon); Tiger Analytics sits in the Mercury Block, Capgemini Engineering in the Vector Block of phase III, and OpenStreetMap records a JP Morgan office building on its ORR frontage.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecoworld
techParks.description: RMZ's large SEZ campus on the Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road at Devarabeesanahalli, built as numbered campuses (5B, 6A/6B, 7, 8A, 8B, 10A); it is the densest BFSI cluster in the city, with Morgan Stanley, State Street (three campuses), Standard Chartered GBS, KPMG Global Services and Allstate India; Brookfield India REIT agreed to acquire it in 2025.

techParks.name: RMZ Ecospace
techParks.description: RMZ's earlier campus on the Outer Ring Road at Bellandur, adjoining the Pritech Park SEZ; Capgemini's 6B Building and Accenture's Pritech Annexe (Block 15) are listed under it.

techParks.name: Pritech Park SEZ
techParks.description: An IT/ITES SEZ at Bellandur Village on the Outer Ring Road, developed by RMZ beside Ecospace and built as numbered blocks (7, 10, 12/12A, 14, 15); Accenture has three listed sites plus its Bengaluru Innovation Hub here, and Societe Generale lists a Pvt Ltd entity in Block 12/12A.

techParks.name: RMZ Infinity
techParks.description: RMZ's tower complex on Old Madras Road at Benniganahalli, long associated with the Thomson Reuters / Refinitiv (now LSEG) Bengaluru operation; OpenStreetMap also records EY here.

techParks.name: Manyata Tech Park
techParks.description: Embassy REIT's largest campus, in the north of the city on the Hebbal-KR Puram Outer Ring Road, built as tree-named blocks (Acacia, Eucalyptus, Mahogany, Rosewood, Hazel); ANZ has been a tenant since 2005 across about 6.2 lakh sq ft, Fidelity's two entities sit in Mahogany and Rosewood, and Concentrix is in Block D1.

techParks.name: International Tech Park Bangalore
techParks.description: The 1994 Singapore-Karnataka joint venture park in Whitefield, now CapitaLand's, built as named buildings (Voyager, Aviator, Victor, Discoverer); Societe Generale's Global Solution Centre and Capital One's India office are both in the Voyager Building, and Mu Sigma occupies floors 10-14 of the Aviator Building.

techParks.name: Cessna Business Park
techParks.description: A business park on the Outer Ring Road at Kadubeesanahalli opposite Embassy TechVillage, developed in phases by Prestige and Umiya; Standard Chartered lists an office on the 8th floor of Umiya Business Bay No.2 here.

techParks.name: Helios Business Park
aliases: Helios Business Park, 150 Outer Ring Road
techParks.description: Kalyani Developers' 22-acre, roughly 2.8 million sq ft park at 150 Outer Ring Road, Kadubeesanahalli, built as wings A-E; it is the registered address of Goldman Sachs Services Private Limited and houses the firm's Bengaluru engineering and quant campus.

techParks.name: Bagmane World Technology Center
techParks.description: Bagmane's SEZ-II campus at Doddanekundi on the KR Puram Outer Ring Road; Accenture's official location list names 'Bagmane Developers SEZ-II, Doddanekundi' and OpenStreetMap records a Visa office here.

techParks.name: Bagmane Constellation Business Park
techParks.description: Bagmane's star-named-tower campus (Taurus, Virgo) at Doddanekundi; property press names Deloitte among its multinational tenants, and OpenStreetMap records EY and NatWest offices inside it.

techParks.name: Bagmane Capital
techParks.description: Bagmane's newer campus at KR Puram east of Constellation; American Express's careers site places its Bengaluru technology office in a newly constructed building here.

techParks.name: Bagmane Tech Park
aliases: Bagmane Tech Park CV Raman Nagar
techParks.description: Bagmane's original 2001 park at CV Raman Nagar with named blocks (Tridib, Laurel, Lakeview); Grant Thornton Bharat is on the 5th floor of Block A, Bagmane Tridib, and OpenStreetMap records PwC's Acceleration Center and a Cognizant building here.

techParks.name: Bagmane Solarium City
techParks.description: Bagmane's campus on Kundalahalli Road at Doddanekundi (KR Puram Hobli); Northern Trust's consolidated Bengaluru office occupies floors 3 to 8 of a building here, and OpenStreetMap records Cognizant too.

techParks.name: Divyasree Technopark
techParks.description: DivyaSree's IT/ITES SEZ at Kundalahalli Village on the ITPL Main Road (distinct from Divyasree Technopolis at Yemalur); Accenture and Capgemini both list campuses here (Capgemini in blocks B4, B5, A5 and A6) and Cognizant's Bengaluru office page gives the same SEZ.

techParks.name: Bhartiya Centre of Information Technology
techParks.description: The IT campus inside Bhartiya City in north Bengaluru off Thanisandra Main Road; OpenStreetMap records MUFG's India global service centre in Block 2, South Wing.

techParks.name: Prestige Trade Tower
techParks.description: Prestige's high-rise office tower on Palace Road in the central business district; OpenStreetMap records the Deloitte India office here (the POI is named 'Prestige Deloitte').

techParks.name: UB City
techParks.description: The Prestige-UB luxury commercial complex on Vittal Mallya Road; BCG's Bengaluru office is on the 17th floor of Canberra Tower B.

techParks.name: Electronics City Phase 1
techParks.description: The original KIADB electronics industrial estate on Hosur Road in the south of the city; Infosys BPM's registered office is on the Infosys campus here, Equiniti opened its 21,000 sq ft digital hub in the locality in 2019, and OpenStreetMap records a Genpact premises beside HP's campus.

techParks.name: Infosys Electronics City Campus
techParks.description: Infosys's corporate headquarters campus at plots 26/3, 26/4 and 26/6, Hosur Road, Electronics City; Infosys BPM Limited gives the same plot numbers as its Bengaluru address.

techParks.name: RMZ Centennial
techParks.description: RMZ's office campus at Kundalahalli on the ITPL Main Road; OpenStreetMap records a WNS delivery centre here.

techParks.name: Prestige Technopolis
techParks.locality: Adugodi / Dairy Circle (Dr M H Marigowda Road)
techParks.description: A Prestige office building on Dr M H Marigowda Road at Adugodi near Dairy Circle; Accenture's official location list includes it (OpenStreetMap labels the site Accenture BDC-9).

techParks.name: RMZ Futura
techParks.description: RMZ's campus on Bannerghatta Main Road at Bilekahalli; a directory listing and an OpenStreetMap POI both place HSBC Electronic Data Processing India here.

techParks.name: Brigade Magnum
techParks.description: Brigade's office tower on Bellary Road at Hebbal; OpenStreetMap records a PwC office here (unconfirmed elsewhere).

techParks.name: EPIP Zone Whitefield
techParks.description: KIADB's Export Promotion Industrial Park at Whitefield; Capgemini Technology Services' EPIP Campus (plots 155-170, EPIP Phase II) is the lens's one site here, and the coordinates are that campus's OpenStreetMap polygon rather than the whole zone.

techParks.name: Global Village Tech Park
techParks.description: The IT SEZ on Mysore Road at Mylasandra (RVCE Post), now marketed as Sattva Global City; Capgemini Engineering's Global Edge office is here.

techParks.name: Salarpuria Sattva Softzone
techParks.description: A Salarpuria Sattva IT building on the Sarjapur Outer Ring Road at Bellandur (Iblur); OpenStreetMap records Genpact and HSBC offices here.

techParks.name: Kalyani Tech Park
techParks.description: Kalyani Developers' tech park on the ITPL Main Road at Brookefield; OpenStreetMap records a 'Capgemini Dartmoor Block' building inside it, adjoining Capgemini's EPIP campus.

techParks.name: Divyasree 77 Town Centre
techParks.description: DivyaSree's mixed-use office campus at Yemalur between the Outer Ring Road and the airport road; OpenStreetMap records Deloitte and Thomson Reuters offices inside it (unconfirmed elsewhere).

techParks.name: Prestige RMZ Startech
techParks.description: The Prestige-RMZ office campus at 140 Industrial Layout, Koramangala, on Hosur Road; Accenture's official list includes 'RMZ Star Tech' (OpenStreetMap labels it Accenture BDC-14).

techParks.name: RGA Tech Park
techParks.description: An IT park on Sarjapur Road at Carmelaram; OpenStreetMap records an Accenture office here (it is not on Accenture's official Bengaluru list).

techParks.name: IBC Knowledge Park
techParks.description: An office park on Bannerghatta Road near Dairy Circle; OpenStreetMap maps an 'Accenture, IBC Knowledge Park' building (not on Accenture's current official list).

companies.name: Goldman Sachs
companies.description: Investment bank; its Bengaluru office (opened 2004) is Goldman's largest outside New York, a 9,000+ engineering, quant and operations centre.

offices.label: Bengaluru campus - Helios Business Park
offices.address: Helios Business Park, 150 Outer Ring Road, Kadubeesanahalli, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: Goldman Sachs Services Private Limited's legal and HQ address is 'Helios Business Park, 150 Outer Ring Road, Kadubeesanahalli, Bangalore 560103' in its LEI record (https://lei.bloomberg.com/leis/view/549300W3CGEVSBW7KS96) and on goldmansachs.com/worldwide/india; the point is Nominatim's hit for 150 Outer Ring Road.

companies.name: JPMorgan Chase
companies.description: Universal bank with 50,000+ staff in India; Bengaluru hosts a corporate centre for technology, operations and analytics, anchored by a 1.1 million sq ft built-to-suit building at Embassy TechVillage.

offices.label: Embassy TechVillage corporate centre (Block 8D)
offices.address: Block 8D, Embassy TechVillage, Outer Ring Road, Devarabeesanahalli, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: Embassy REIT announced JPMorgan Chase's inauguration of a 1.1 msf built-to-suit corporate centre at Embassy TechVillage on 10 Aug 2023 (https://www.embassyofficeparks.com/newsroom/press/embassy-reit-welcomes-jpmorgan-chase-to-its-11-msf-built-to-suit-corporate-centre-at-embassy-techvillage-in-bengaluru); a registered lease covers 5.6 lakh sq ft across 11 floors of Block 8D (https://therealtytoday.com/news/jp-morgan-leases-56-lakh-sq-ft-office-space-in-bengalurus-embassy-techvillage-for-7-years). Point is Nominatim's Block 8D.

offices.label: Prestige Tech Park
offices.address: Prestige Tech Park, Outer Ring Road, Kadubeesanahalli, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: OpenStreetMap maps an office building named 'JP Morgan' on the Outer Ring Road frontage of Prestige Tech Park (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/148325529); no company page or lease notice was found to confirm it, so it is recorded at low confidence.

companies.name: Morgan Stanley
companies.description: Investment bank whose Bengaluru centre (Morgan Stanley Advantage Services) does technology and operations; opened at RMZ Ecoworld in 2015 and expanded there by 1.6 lakh sq ft from January 2026.

offices.label: RMZ Ecoworld (Campus 8B / Building 10A)
offices.address: RMZ Ecoworld, Campus 8B, Sarjapur-Marathahalli Outer Ring Road, Devarabeesanahalli, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: Morgan Stanley's 2015 press release inaugurated its Bengaluru office 'in the RMZ Ecoworld Building' (https://www.morganstanley.com/press-releases/morgan-stanley-inaugurates-new-office-in-bengaluru-india_4c98a2fa-7aca-477a-9643-ad7390e4995d); Built In lists 'RMZ Ecoworld, Campus 8B Level 2-5' (https://builtinbengaluru.in/company/morgan-stanley/offices) and a 2025 registration shows a further 1.58 lakh sq ft on the 8th-9th floors from 10 Jan 2026 (https://therealtytoday.com/news/commercial/morgan-stanley-secures-16-lakh-sq-ft-grade-a-office-space-in-bengaluru/). Park centroid used.

companies.name: Wells Fargo
companies.description: US bank whose India arm (Wells Fargo International Solutions) runs technology and operations from Bengaluru and Hyderabad; the Bengaluru base is the Wells Fargo Centre at Embassy TechVillage, leased to 2032.

offices.label: Wells Fargo Centre - Embassy TechVillage
offices.address: Wells Fargo Centre, Embassy Tech Village SEZ, Outer Ring Road, Devarabeesanahalli, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: The GST registration of Wells Fargo International Solutions gives 'Wells Fargo Centre, Embassy Tech Village SEZ, Outer Ring Road, Devarabeesanahalli, 560103' (https://piceapp.com/gst-number-search/wells-fargo-international-solutions-private-limited-29aaacw6592n1zg/); a 2022 report says the lease on its two buildings there runs to June 2032 (https://www.commercialdesignindia.com/insights/wells-fargos-india-arm-renews-lease-for-two-commercial-buildings-in-bengaluru). Point is OSM's Wells Fargo building.

companies.name: ANZ
aliases: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group
companies.description: Australian bank whose Bengaluru Group Capability Centre (ANZ Support Services India, 9,000+ people, in the city since 1988) is its largest site outside Australia; main campus at Embassy Manyata since 2005 plus a tower at Embassy TechVillage.

offices.label: Embassy Manyata campus (Acacia / Eucalyptus)
offices.address: Acacia Parcel 1, Embassy Manyata Business Park, Outer Ring Road, Nagavara, Bengaluru 560045
offices.evidence: ANZ's careers page gives 'Acacia Parcel 1, Embassy Manyata Business Park, Outer Ring Road, Rachenahalli Village, Nagavara, 560045' (https://www.anz.com.au/careers/our-teams/group-capability-centre/bengaluru/); Built In lists the Eucalyptus block and a 2024 report says ANZ renewed 6.18 lakh sq ft over 18 floors, tenant since 2005 (https://therealtytoday.com/news/anz-renews-6-lakh-sq-ft-embassy-manyata-office-lease-in-bengaluru-for-6-crore-monthly). Point is Nominatim's Acacia block.

offices.label: Embassy TechVillage - Hibiscus (Tower 1, 2B)
offices.address: 2B Tower 1 (Hibiscus), Embassy Tech Village, Devarabeesanahalli, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: ANZ's careers page lists a second Bengaluru office at '2B Tower 1 (Hibiscus), Embassy Tech Village, 6th & 7th Floor, Devarabeesanahalli Village, 560103' (https://www.anz.com.au/careers/our-teams/group-capability-centre/bengaluru/); park centroid used.

companies.name: Societe Generale
companies.description: French bank whose Global Solution Centre in Bengaluru (founded 2000, with Chennai) does IT, operations and analytics; the main site is the Voyager Building at ITPB, Whitefield, with a second entity listed at Pritech Park, Bellandur.

offices.label: Global Solution Centre - Voyager Building, ITPB
offices.address: Voyager Building, 10th Floor, ITPB (Ascendas ITPB SEZ), Whitefield Road, Bengaluru 560066
offices.evidence: Societe Generale's own office page gives 'Voyager Building, 10F, ITPB, Whitefield Road, 560066' (https://wholesale.banking.societegenerale.com/en/about/locations/worldwide-details/office/bangalore-global-solution-centre-1) and Built In repeats '10th Floor, Voyager Building, ITPB, Whitefield Road' (https://builtinbengaluru.in/company/societe-generale-global-solution-centre/offices); point is OSM's Societe Generale POI inside ITPB.

offices.label: Pritech Park SEZ - Block 12/12A
offices.address: Block 12/12A, Pritech Park SEZ, Outer Ring Road, Bellandur Village, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: SocGen's India country page lists a Pvt Ltd entity at 'Pritech Park SEZ, Block 12/12A, Varthur Hobli, Bellandur Village, 560103' (https://wholesale.banking.societegenerale.com/en/about/locations/country-details/country/india-2/); Nominatim's Pritech Park point used, so park-level only.

companies.name: Fidelity Investments
companies.description: Boston asset manager (FMR); Fidelity Business Services India, set up in Bengaluru in 2003, runs technology and operations from Embassy GolfLinks (registered office) and Embassy Manyata.

offices.label: Pinehurst - Embassy GolfLinks
offices.address: Pinehurst, Embassy Golf Links Business Park, Off Intermediate Ring Road, Bengaluru 560071
offices.evidence: Fidelity's India careers site lists 'Fidelity Business Services India Pvt. Ltd., Embassy Golf Links Business Park, Intermediate Ring Road, 560071' (Pinehurst) and says operations began in Bengaluru in 2003 (https://jobs.fidelity.com/in/locations/bengaluru-india/); point is OSM's Fidelity POI inside the park.

offices.label: Mahogany F2 - Embassy Manyata
offices.address: 2nd & 3rd Floor, F2 Mahogany, Manyata Embassy Business Park, Outer Ring Road, Bengaluru 560045
offices.evidence: The same Fidelity page lists '2nd and 3rd Floor, F2, Mahogany, Manyata Embassy Business Park, Outer Ring Road, 560045' (https://jobs.fidelity.com/in/locations/bengaluru-india/); point is Nominatim's Mahogany block.

companies.name: Fidelity International
aliases: FIL India Business and Research Services
companies.description: London/Bermuda asset manager (FIL, separate from Fidelity Investments); FIL India Business and Research Services runs a Bengaluru office at Embassy Manyata alongside its larger Gurugram centre.

offices.label: Rosewood Block J - Embassy Manyata
offices.address: 4th Floor, Block J (Rosewood), Embassy Manyata Business Park, Nagavara, Bengaluru 560045
offices.evidence: Fidelity International's careers site lists 'FIL India Business and Research Services, 4th Floor, Block J (Rosewood), Embassy Manyata Business Park, Nagavara Village, 560045' (https://careers.fidelityinternational.com/locations/india/offices/); park centroid used.

companies.name: Northern Trust
companies.description: Chicago custodian and asset manager; its Bengaluru operations and technology centre consolidated three earlier offices into one building on Kundalahalli Road (Bagmane Solarium City).

offices.label: Bengaluru office - Kundalahalli Road (Bagmane Solarium City)
offices.address: Kundalahalli Road, Floors 3-8, Doddanekundi Village, K R Puram Hobli, Bengaluru 560037
offices.evidence: Northern Trust's careers page gives 'Kundalahalli Road, Floors 3 to 8, K R Puram Hobli, Doddanekundi Village' and says three offices were consolidated here (https://www.northerntrust.com/united-states/about-us/careers/working-in-bangalore); Built In repeats the address with pin 560037 (https://builtinbengaluru.in/company/northern-trust/offices). Point is OSM's Northern Trust POI, which falls inside the Bagmane Solarium City polygon.

companies.name: State Street
aliases: State Street Corporate Services Mumbai Private Limited
companies.description: Boston custodian bank; State Street Corporate Services and State Street Global Advisors India occupy three campuses at RMZ Ecoworld in Bengaluru, one of nine Indian sites.

offices.label: RMZ Ecoworld (Campus 6A/6B, 7 and 8A)

offices.evidence: State Street's own office-locations page lists three Bengaluru addresses: 'Ecoworld, Campus 6A and 6B, 2nd/3rd/4th & 6th Floor', 'Ecoworld, Campus 7, 7th & 8th Floor' and SSGA at 'Ecoworld, Campus 8A, 4th Floor', all Outer Ring Road, Varthur Hobli, 560103 (https://www.statestreet.com/us/en/asset-manager/about/our-story/office-locations); park centroid used.

companies.name: HSBC
companies.description: HSBC runs Global Service and Technology Centres in Bengaluru (about 47,000 staff across India); staff are spread over several buildings and will consolidate into a 1.2 million sq ft pre-leased campus at Prestige JRC Signature Towers on the Outer Ring Road, due around 2027.

offices.label: HSBC EDPI - Dr M H Marigowda Road, Adugodi
offices.address: No 8/2, 5th-7th Floor, Dr M H Marigowda Road, Bengaluru 560029
offices.evidence: Built In lists HSBC's Bengaluru office as 'No 8/2 (5th/6th/7th Floor), Dr. M H Marigowda Road, 560029' (https://builtinbengaluru.in/company/hsbc/offices); the point is Photon's street-level hit for that address.

offices.label: RMZ Futura - Bannerghatta Road
offices.address: RMZ Futura, Bannerghatta Main Road, Bilekahalli, Bengaluru 560076
offices.evidence: A directory listing places HSBC Electronic Data Processing India at RMZ Futura I, Bannerghatta Main Road, Bilekahalli (https://www.explurger.com/pd/33ypfzpwqgfuyvd2n) and OSM records an HSBC POI inside the RMZ Futura polygon (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/10697707100).

offices.label: Salarpuria Sattva Softzone - Bellandur
offices.address: Salarpuria Softzone, Sarjapur Outer Ring Road, Bellandur, Bengaluru 560103
offices.evidence: OpenStreetMap records an HSBC POI inside the Salarpuria Softzone building at Bellandur (https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/3477883870); not confirmed by any company page, so low confidence.

companies.name: Standard Chartered

offices.label: GBS centre - RMZ Ecoworld
offices.address: RMZ Ecoworld, Outer Ring Road, Devarabeesanahalli, Bengaluru 560103

Park centroid used.

offices.evidence: Built In lists Standard Chartered at '8th Floor, Umiya Business Bay No.2, Cessna Business Park, Outer Ring Road, 560103' (https://builtinbengaluru.in/company/standard-chartered/offices); park centroid used.

companies.name: Capital One

companies.name: Visa

coverageNotes: EVIDENCE GRADES USED: high = the company's own page or two independent sources; medium = one secondary source (a Built In office page, a lease report, a directory) OR an OpenStreetMap office POI named for the company and lying inside a named park polygon; low = an OSM POI with no corroboration, a legacy brand name, or an entry absent from the company's own current list. Park-centroid coordinates are marked geocodeSource=park-centroid and capped at medium even where the address is official (State Street, Fidelity International, Capital One, Tiger Analytics, Concentrix, Capgemini 5B/Vector/Global Village, ANZ Hibiscus, SocGen Pritech). SEARCH BUDGET: the shared WebSearch quota ran out after ~16 queries, so most verification was by fetching company location pages, Built In Bengaluru office pages, lease reports and the OSM extract; many corporate sites (goldmansachs.com, societegenerale.com, pwc.in, exlservice.com, mckinsey.com, ey.com, americanexpress.com, deloitte.com office locator, lseg.com, natwestgroup.com, thomsonreuters.com, moodys.com, spglobal.com, fisglobal.com, allstateindia.com (JS-only), genpact.com, wns.com, hgs.com, tp.com) returned 403/404/503 or no address, which is why several well-known tenants rest on OSM + one secondary source. LEFT OUT FOR LACK OF A MAPPABLE ADDRESS: Citi (only an OSM POI at Brigade Magnum, Hebbal; no Citi page or press names a Bengaluru GCC), Deutsche Bank (careers page confirms a Bengaluru technology centre and a 1994 branch but gives no address; India contact page lists only Mumbai/GIFT City), FIS (no Bengaluru address found), Danske Bank, AXA, Sun Life, First American, Ocwen, Broadridge, ACI Worldwide (not researched within budget). NOT IN BENGALURU AS FAR AS COULD BE ESTABLISHED, so omitted: Ameriprise (Gurugram/Noida), Prudential, MetLife (Noida/Hyderabad), Aviva (Gurugram), Allianz (Pune/Trivandrum), Zurich (only an ambiguous OSM 'Zurich Pvt Ltd' POI at Brookefield), Chubb and Travelers (Hyderabad), Moody's, MSCI and Bloomberg (Mumbai/Gurugram), S&P Global (Hyderabad/Gurugram/Mumbai/Ahmedabad), Mastercard (Pune/Gurugram), Kearney, Gartner and Forrester (no Bengaluru office evidence), Teleperformance (site names only '40+ delivery centres'), HGS (page empty), LatentView (redirect, no data). Lowe's, Target, Walmart and Tesco appear in the OSM extract but are retail/other lenses and were excluded as instructed. UNCONFIRMED BUT NOTED: Goldman Sachs is widely reported to have consolidated out of Embassy GolfLinks (Crystal Downs) into Helios around 2019-21; the OSM Goldman POI still inside EGL was treated as stale and not recorded. HSBC's 1.2 million sq ft, 20-year pre-lease at Prestige JRC Signature Towers (Outer Ring Road, due about Oct 2027) is a letter of intent with no geocodable address yet, so it is described but not recorded as a planned office. JPMorgan at Prestige Tech Park rests only on an OSM building footprint. Morgan Stanley's Jan-2026 1.58 lakh sq ft expansion is inside the same Ecoworld entry. Standard Chartered's GBS is placed at Ecoworld per its press release; a CFA Institute listing says Ecospace, which adjoins it. Bain's official street (Vittal Mallya Road) and the OSM Bain POI (700 m south) disagree; the POI coordinates were used with the official address text. Several Accenture block positions inside Pritech Park are approximate (one OSM POI per listed block). Headcounts are given only where a source states them (Goldman 9,000+, ANZ 9,000+).
